about: Endless Sky planets the player can stake a claim on. One row = one ES mission + one DSP binding slot. Planet names must exist in the player's Endless Sky data/map planets.txt.

rows.pitch: A surveyor in a mud-spattered coat waves a land deed at you. "Marsh plot out past the textile mills. Nobody wants it. Five thousand and it's yours, mineral rights included."
The mining guild is auctioning off a played-out lava field. The veins near the surface are gone, but the guild clerk swears an automated foundry could still turn a profit.
A frostbitten homesteader is selling the claim to a glacier valley he never managed to farm. "Cold enough to keep any machine from overheating," he says, a little too eagerly.
